---
title: 'Unlock the Lab: sample studies'
subtitle: Six studies for discussion, with an answer key for the facilitator
---

```{r}
#| include: false
# The studies, their texts and the expert's feedback come from the app's
# files (see handouts.R); the six are chosen by choose_sample_studies().
source('handouts.R')
data <- load_handout_data()
text <- function(key, ...) tr(data$strings, key, list(...))
md <- function(key, ...) html_to_md(text(key, ...))
picked <- choose_sample_studies(data$studies, data$criteria$key)
labels <- paste('Study', LETTERS[seq_along(picked)])
quality <- function(band) md(paste0('common.quality.', band))
range_of <- function(band) md(paste0('common.quality.', band, 'Range'))
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
emit(footer_metadata(data))
```

# About this set

```{r}
#| results: asis
emit(
    sprintf(paste('These %s fictional studies come from Unlock the Lab and are printed as participants',
                  'see them in the app, with the two answers that the app asks for. Use them for',
                  'discussion in groups, as a warm-up before the app or for anyone taking part on',
                  'paper. The evaluation guide has the rubric and the glossary to go with them.'),
            number_words(length(picked))),
    sprintf(
        paste('The set covers the three quality bands of the expert ratings: %s. From each band it',
              'takes the study that is hardest to judge, with the most criteria whose band differs',
              'from the overall one, and the clearest, with the fewest, where possible with a',
              'different expert rating. The studies keep their order in the app, so their letters',
              'say nothing about their quality.'),
        and_list(vapply(c('low', 'medium', 'high'), function(band) {
            sprintf('%s (%s)', quality(band), tolower(range_of(band)))
        }, ''))
    ),
    paste('Each study is on its own page. The answer key at the end gives the expert\'s rating, a',
          'summary and a note on each criterion; keep it back until everyone has answered.',
          'To play \'Predict the crowd\' on paper, collect the ratings, work out the group\'s',
          'average for each study and compare it with the predictions. The live dashboard shows',
          'how everyone who has used the app rated each study, under the dashboard number given in',
          'the answer key.')
)
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
for (i in seq_along(picked)) emit(study_card_md(data, picked[[i]], labels[i]))
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
answer_key <- 'Answer key'
emit(
    page_start('**For the facilitator**'),
    sprintf('# %s {.unnumbered}', answer_key),
    'The expert\'s feedback is the same as the app shows after each study.',
    md_table(
        c('Study', 'Title', 'Expert rating', 'Quality', 'Dashboard number'),
        lapply(seq_along(picked), function(i) {
            study <- picked[[i]]
            c(labels[i], html_to_md(study$title), study$expertRating, quality(study$band),
              study$number)
        }),
        c(10, 44, 12, 18, 16)
    )
)
for (i in seq_along(picked)) {
    study <- picked[[i]]
    # Each study's key has a page of its own, so it can be printed alone.
    emit(
        page_start(sprintf('**%s**', answer_key)),
        sprintf('## %s: %s {.unnumbered}', labels[i], html_to_md(study$title)),
        sprintf('**%s** · %s', md('app.feedback.expertRating', rating = study$expertRating),
                quality(study$band)),
        html_to_md(study$feedback$summary),
        sprintf('**%s**', md('app.feedback.criteriaHeading')),
        md_table(
            c(md('app.guide.rubricCriterion'), 'Band', 'Note'),
            lapply(data$criteria$key, function(key) {
                criterion <- study$feedback$criteria[[key]]
                c(sprintf('**%s**', md(paste0('common.criteria.', key))),
                  band_label(data, criterion$band), html_to_md(criterion$note))
            }),
            c(18, 12, 70)
        )
    )
}
emit('---', closing_line(data))
```
